concerns.text: T013b checks the 2005-2020 dataset (occurrence_2005_2020.csv) but outputs to 'metrics/recent_insufficient_data.json', while T029b checks the same dataset but outputs to 'metrics/insufficient_data.json'. This creates a semantic contradiction in the Single Source of Truth for the FR-006 validation artifact, risking duplicate or missed flags.

FR-006 mandates excluding species with <100 records from the analysis to ensure statistical power. T013 (historical training prep) applies thinning but lacks the logic to flag or exclude species failing the <100 count threshold. This silently weakens the FR-006 constraint for the training phase, allowing models to be trained on statistically underpowered data.

T034 requires multiple-comparison correction for 'p-values from statistical tests run in T032', but T032 (permutation tests) and T030/T031 do not define the specific 'family' of hypotheses to be corrected. Without a defined set of comparisons (e.g., 'all model pairs across all species'), the correction is untestable and the FR-005 requirement is semantically weakened to an unimplementable instruction.

T010 and T011 hardcode 'maxResults=300' for GBIF pagination. This silently relaxes FR-001's requirement to 'download historical occurrence records' by artificially capping the dataset size. For rare species, this will trigger the FR-006 <100 record threshold artificially, skewing results and violating the intent of the data acquisition requirement.

T027 mandates running 'nvidia-smi' to verify no GPU usage. This command is not available on standard GitHub Actions CPU runners (which lack NVIDIA drivers), causing the verification step to fail or be irrelevant. This weakens the FR-003/FR-004 constraint enforcement by using an invalid verification method that cannot guarantee the constraint.

T040 restricts the Reference-Validator Agent to run only on specific file modifications, excluding 'plan.md' and 'implementation-plan/'. Constitution Principle II requires verification of *every* external citation in *any* artifact. This task scope silently narrows the constitutional requirement, allowing unverified citations in design artifacts to bypass the gate.
